title: Dedicated Lead qualification workflow contracts
decisions: NURTURE, OPPORTUNITY and DIRECT_SALE are separate backend-orchestrated commands with distinct closed request DTOs and transaction boundaries.
Every qualification command requires Idempotency-Key and If-Match and returns authoritative Lead/workflow evidence.
Relationship resolution, downstream aggregate IDs, document numbers, totals, tax, rounding, actor identity, timestamps and audit evidence remain backend authority.
The generic qualifyLead operation is retired and remains blocked without a 2xx response.
Connected mode never coordinates cross-module transactions or falls back to the browser workflow.
